title: Elf Bar 600 Watermelon Strawberry Prefilled Vape Pods 20mg - 2PK
description: These Elf Bar 600 Watermelon Strawberry Prefilled Pods are designed for use with the Elf Bar 600 Prefilled Pod Kit, offering a fruity, fuss-free way to enjoy vaping. Each pod is prefilled with 20mg nicotine salt e-liquid, providing up to 600 puffs and a smooth MTL draw. The flavour blends fresh, juicy Watermelon with the ripe sweetness of Strawberry for a bright and summery fruit combination that’s simple yet satisfying. Pods can be replaced instantly when empty—just click in a fresh one for straightforward vaping.
